title: FACS-based isolation of fixed mouse neuronal nuclei for ATAC-seq and Hi-C
protocol: Sacrifice mouse with isoflurane and perfuse with cold PBS.
Isolate cortex on ice.
Homogenize cortical tissue in 500 μl of ice-cold low sucrose buffer using a Dounce homogenizer 10–15 times on ice.
Store the homogenate at 4°C, do not store for more than 2 weeks.
Measure volume of homogenate and add an equal amount of low sucrose buffer with 2% formaldehyde to achieve a final concentration of 1% formaldehyde in low sucrose buffer.
Mix well and incubate for 10 minutes at 22°C.
Add glycine to the homogenate to achieve a 0.2M glycine solution.
Incubate gently mixed homogenate for 10 minutes at 22°C to quench crosslinking reaction.
Centrifuge the samples for 5 min at 2000 g at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 3 mL of low sucrose buffer with PIC.
Homogenize each sample using a mechanical homogenizer (rotor/stator) at 15 rpm, repeating four times for approximately 6 seconds each time.
Centrifuge the samples for 5 min at 2000 g at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Prepare iodixanol gradient to isolate nuclei using a solution of 5 volumes Optiprep 60% iodixanol and 1 volume dilution solution stored at 4°C, not more than one month old.
Dilute iodixanol solution with resuspension buffer to prepare two gradient solutions: 22% and 43% iodixanol.
Keep the gradient solutions on ice.
Resuspend the pellet from step 8 in 2 mL of 22% iodixanol solution.
Place 1 mL of 43% iodixanol solution in a 15 mL tube, then carefully add a layer of 1 mL of 22% iodixanol solution.
On top, add 2 mL of tissue homogenate in 22% iodixanol solution.
Centrifuge at 2600 g for 40 min at 4°C on the bucket centrifuge.
Collect the nuclei interphase between 43% iodixanol solution and other layers.
Dilute the nuclei interphase fraction with resuspension solution containing 1% BSA (1:2).
Centrifuge at 3200 g for 10 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash the pellet once with 1 mL of resuspension solution containing 1% BSA.
Centrifuge at 3200 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the liquid and resuspend the pellet in 200 μL PBST with 5% BSA and 3% goat serum.
Take out 10 μL of pellet and dilute it in PBST with 5% BSA up to 500 μL for non-stained control for FACS.
Add 4 μL of NeuN-PE antibody to 190 μL of resuspended pellet and incubate for 30 min on ice.
Centrifuge at 3200 g for 5 min at 4°C, discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 200 μL PBST with 5% BSA.
Centrifuge at 3200 g for 5 min at 4°C, discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of PBST with 5% BSA.
Transfer the solution to Falcon™ Round-Bottom Polystyrene Test Tubes through Cell Strainer Snap Cap using a 35-μm cell strainer.
Immunostain nuclei with an antibody specific to NeuN.
Filter immunostained nuclei through a 35-μm cell strainer.
Sort NeuN-positive populations on a BD Biosciences FacsAria flow sorter.
Centrifuge the solution containing sorted nuclei at 3200 g for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend the pellet of fixed nuclei in 50 μl of ultra-pure water.
Keep the cell pellet on ice.
Collect 100,000 nuclei from the pellet for transposition reaction.
Use collected nuclei for downstream applications such as ATAC-seq.
Resuspend the pellet in the transposition reaction mix.
Incubate the transposition reaction at 37°C for 30 min with shaking (1400 rpm).
Add an equal volume of 2× reverse-crosslinked solution to the mixture.
Incubate the mixture at 65°C without shaking for 4–5 h.
Purify the transposed DNA using a PCR Purification kit and elute in 10 μL of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0.
Amplify the transposed DNA fragments according to the protocol table.
Perform qPCR to choose an additional number of cycles.
Amplify the rest of the previously PCR-amplified DNA with the chosen additional number of cycles.
Check the library size by electrophoresis or other suitable methods.
Add 0.5 volumes of AMPure XP beads to the solution.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting.
Incubate for 10 min at 22°C, mixing occasionally.
Separate the beads on a magnet for 2–3 min.
Transfer the solution to a new tube.
Add 1.3 volumes of AMPure XP beads to the solution.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting.
Incubate for 10 min at 22°C.
Mix from time to time during the incubation.
Place the tube on a magnet for 2–3 min.
Discard the solution after placing the tube on the magnet.
Add 3 volumes of fresh 75% ethanol to wash the beads.
Wash the beads on the magnet with the added ethanol.
Discard the ethanol solution after washing.
Repeat the ethanol washing step again.
Separate the beads on the magnet and discard the solution.
Leave the beads on the magnet for 5–10 min to air-dry from ethanol.
Remove the tube from the magnet once dry.
Add 10 μL of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 to elute DNA.
Mix gently by pipetting after adding the elution buffer.
Incubate for 10 min at 22°C with the elution solution.
Place the tube on the magnet for 2–3 min after incubation.
Transfer the eluted solution to a fresh tube.
Add 11 μL of 10× DpnII buffer (up to 1.1×) to the mixture.
Add 1.5 μL of 20% SDS (final concentration 0.3%) to the mixture.
Resuspend carefully after adding buffers and SDS.
Incubate for 1 hour at 37°C with shaking at 1400 rpm.
Add 27 μL of 20% Triton-X100 (final concentration 1.8%) to the mixture.
Add 173 μL of 1.1× DpnII buffer to reach a total volume of 300 μL.
Incubate 1 h at 37°C with shaking 1400 rpm.
Take 15 μL of mixture for integrity control.
Place the taken mixture at 4°C until step 7.
Add 4 μL (200 U) of DpnII to the mixture and resuspend gently.
Incubate 3–4 h at 37°C with shaking 1400 rpm.
Incubate 20 min at 65°C to inactivate DpnII.
Take 15 μL of mixture for digestion control.
Place the taken mixture at 4°C until step 7.
Centrifuge at 3200 g for 10 min at 20°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 100 μL of 1× NEB2 buffer.
Add 20 μL of mixture to the 100 μL sample.
Incubate 1.5 h at 37°C with shaking 1000 rpm.
Centrifuge at 3200 g for 10 min at 20°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 196.5 μL of 1× T4 ligase buffer, 1 μL BSA, and 2.5 μL (1000 U) of T4 ligase to the sample.
Incubate at 20°C for 16–18 h with shaking 1400 rpm.
Add 4 μL of Proteinase K and 10 μL 20% SDS to the samples.
Add 2 μL of Proteinase K, 10 μL 20% SDS, and 185 μL of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 to the integrity and digestion controls.
Incubate all the samples and controls at 65°C without shaking for 4–5 hours.
Cool down the samples at 20°C.
Add PBS up to 300 μL.
Mix 1 volume (300 μL) of phenol:chloroform (1:1) with each sample, mix well.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 20°C at maximum speed.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a new tube.
Mix 1 volume (300 μL) of chloroform with the aqueous phase of each sample, mix thoroughly.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 20°C at maximum speed.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a new tube.
Add 1/9 of the aqueous phase volume (33.3 μL) of 3M sodium acetate solution (pH 5.0), 2 μL of glycogen, and 750 μL of 96% ethanol to each sample, mix well.
Centrifuge for 15 minutes at 4°C at maximum speed.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 500 μL of cold 75% ethanol to wash the pellet.
Centrifuge for 15 minutes at 4°C at maximum speed.
Discard the supernatant.
Air-dry the pellets.
Dissolve the samples in 51 μL of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 and controls in 20 μL of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0.
Use 1 μL of each sample and 10 μL of each control to run on a 0.8% agarose gel.
Check the quality of integrity control, restriction, and ligation.
Incubate at 20°C for 4 hours.
Incubate at 75°C for 20 minutes to inactivate the enzyme.
Cool down the samples and keep at 4°C.
Pause point: Samples might be kept at 4°C for 16–18 h.
Add 150 μL of 2× Sonication buffer and 85 μL of ultra-pure water (300 total).
Store samples at 4°C, do not store more than 2 weeks.
Shear DNA to a size up to 1000 bp.
Solubilize chromatin by sonication for 20 cycles on the Diagenode Bioruptor with high power output, 30 s ON/30 s OFF pulses, +4°C water bath, no floating ice.
Transfer each sample to a 30-kDa Amicon Column and add 150 μL of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 (450 μL total).
Centrifuge for 5 min at 4°C and maximum speed.
Discard the flow-through.
Add 450 μL of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 to the column.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 4°C and maximum speed.
Transfer the solution from the column to a new tube, measure the volume.
Add 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 up to 50 μL.
Add 100 μL (2 volumes) of AmpureXP beads to the solution.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting.
Incubate for 10 min at 22°C, mix from time to time.
Place the tube on a magnet for 2–3 min, then discard the solution.
Add 150 μL (3 volumes) of fresh 75% ethanol, wash the beads on the magnet.
Discard the solution.
Repeat this step again.
Separate the beads on the magnet, discard the solution.
Leave the beads on the magnet for 5–10 min to air-dry the beads from the ethanol.
Add 50 μL of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 to the beads.
Mix gently by pipetting.
Incubate for 10 min at 22°C.
Place the tube on the magnet for 2–3 min.
Transfer the solution to a fresh tube.
Prepare the mixture for end repair.
Incubate for 30 min at 20°C.
Incubate for 20 min at 75°C to deactivate the enzymes.
Keep at 4°C until the next step.
Vortex the MyOne Streptavidin C1 beads.
Transfer 4 μL of bead solution to a low-binding tube.
Resuspend the beads in 100 μL of Tween washing buffer (TWB).
Incubate for 3 min at 20°C with shaking 900 rpm.
Store at 4°C, and do not store more than 2 weeks.
Separate the beads on the magnet.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the beads in 100 μL of TWB.
Incubate for 3 min at 20°C with shaking 900 rpm.
Store at 4°C, and do not store more than 2 weeks.
Separate the beads on the magnet.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the beads in 100 μL of 2× Binding buffer (BB).
Incubate for 3 min at 20°C with shaking 900 rpm.
Store at 4°C, and do not store more than 2 weeks.
Add to the sample from step 111 (70 μL) 30 μL of TLE Buffer.
Mix to reach a total volume of 100 μL.
Store at 4°C, and do not store more than 2 weeks.
Mix the DNA sample (100 μL) with the beads in 2×BB from step 118 (100 μL).
Incubate for 15 min in a shaker at 1200 rpm.
Separate the beads on the magnet, discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the beads in 100 μL of 1× BB.
Separate the beads on the magnet, discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the beads in 100 μL of 1× TLE pH 8.0.
Separate the beads on the magnet, discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the beads in 25 μL of 1× TLE pH 8.0.
Incubate for 30 min at 20°C.
Incubate for 20 min at 65°C to deactivate the enzyme.
Keep at 4°C until the next step.
Separate the beads on the magnet, discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the beads in 70 μL of 1× T4 ligation buffer.
Separate the beads on the magnet, discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the beads in the ligation mixture: 25 μL of 1.1× Quick ligase buffer + 1 μL of Quick T4 ligase.
Add 2.5 μL of 15 uM Illumina TruSeq adapter.
Incubate for 2 h at 20°C.
Incubate for 2 h at 20°C.
Separate the beads on the magnet and discard the supernatant.
Add 100 μl of TWB to the beads, mix carefully by pipetting.
Incubate for 5 min at 20°C.
Separate the beads on the magnet and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the previous two steps (adding TWB and incubating) again.
Resuspend the beads in 100 μL of 1× BB (Binding buffer).
Separate the beads on the magnet and discard the supernatant.
Repeat resuspending the beads in 100 μL of 1× NEBuffer 2.1, then separating them on a magnet and discarding the supernatant again.
Resuspend the beads in 20 μL of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 and transfer to a new tube.
Incubate the beads solution at 98°C for 10 min to remove DNA from the beads.
Separate the beads on the magnet and discard them.
Transfer the supernatant (DNA solution) to a new tube.
Set up Real-Time PCR to determine optimal cycle for final amplification.
Perform PCR reactions on the remaining DNA template with 7 cycles and the same conditions.
Prepare 3 PCR reactions for each sample, using 5 μL of DNA template for each reaction.
Pull together 3 PCR reactions for each sample.
Add 270 μL (1.8 volumes) of AMPure XP beads to the solution.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting.
Incubate for 10 min at 20°C, mixing from time to time.
Place the tube on a magnet for 2–3 min and discard the supernatant.
Add 450 μL (3 volumes) of fresh 75% ethanol and wash the beads on the magnet.
Discard the ethanol solution.
Repeat the washing step with fresh 75% ethanol.
Separate the beads on the magnet, discard the ethanol solution.
Leave the beads on the magnet for 5–10 min to air-dry.
Remove the tube from the magnet.
Add 30 μL of 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 to elute the DNA.
Mix gently by pipetting.
Incubate for 10 min at 20°C.
Place the tube on a magnet for 2–3 min.
Transfer the supernatant containing the eluted DNA to a fresh tube.
Quantify the amount of DNA in the Hi-C library fluorometrically with a Qubit dsDNA Broad Range kit according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Take 1 μL of samples and check the quality by running on a 1% agarose gel.
